dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Aha, now this is my kind of environment. And look at this discerning arrangement of shops.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: I'm impressed, my young apprentice. Perhaps you're more of a business genius than I realized?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: The next time that I, the renowned Lord Sangemah Bay, am negotiating a major business deal, make sure you come along.
